summary: Long prompts are tokenized about 17 times faster: every profile now uses the fastokens tokenizer backend
compatibility: Set VLLM_USE_FASTOKENS=0 to go back to the standard tokenizer backend. A few rare inputs tokenize differently (listed in the runtime README under Tokenizer backend).
details: vLLM tokenizes the whole prompt on every request before prefill, even when the prefix cache already holds it. With fastokens a 300K-token agent conversation takes 27 ms instead of 450 ms on an EPYC 9575F (1M tokens: 85 ms instead of 1.5 s), which comes straight off the time to first token.
Chat templates, tokenizer classes and the reasoning and tool parsers are unchanged; chat prompts tokenized identically for every profile in our tests.
